title: Two children among six dead in plane crash
summary: Divers have found the bodies of six people, including two children, after a plane crashed off the coast of Mississippi on Tuesday, according to the US Coast Guard.
caption: Emergency services were searching the area after the plane crash off the Mississippi coast. Pic: AP

title: US authorises SpaceX to deploy one million satellites to space
summary: The US' Federal Communications Commission is authorising SpaceX to send a million satellites for data centres in space, the agency said.
caption: The SpaceX Starship and Super Heavy v3 Booster lift off in September 2026. Pic: Reuters
